rows.note: Use 炒 as the everyday all-purpose verb for firing someone from a job.

example.english: The company chose to dismiss him.

rows.note: Use this when a court or authority rejects a case, appeal, or application.

example.english: The court decided to dismiss his appeal.
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 bok3 wui4 zo2 keoi5 ge3 soeng6 sou3

rows.note: Use this everyday construction when ordering a person or group to leave.

example.english: The manager told me to leave and decided to dismiss me.
example.jyutping: go3 ging1 lei5 giu3 ngo5 zau2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for dispelling a thought, intention, or idea from someone's mind.

example.jyutping: nei5 daa2 siu1 ni1 go3 nim6 tau4 laa1
